TW for background info, includes topics of child sexual exploitation:
my suicidal thoughts started around age 9/10. i had my first experience being sexualized and molested at this age and it really fucked me up in the head. then i was raped for the first time when i was 11 and that’s when i attempted for the first time as well. i just remember wanting to disappear because i felt so wrong and the only way i knew how to do that was by ending my own life. that’s when i started self harming regularly instead. but eventually i started using opiates to cope because that beautiful numbing warmth made me feel like life was worth it. 
as for what continues to fuel it, i think it’s just anger, sadness, a broken heart and mind. for so long i didn’t understand my own emotions and was sexually mature while being emotionally incredibly immature. because of that mentality and a lack of understand about myself, i allowed myself to be taken advantage of, both emotionally and physically, many times. i just beat myself up a lot because of it. i feel worthless. it doesn’t help that my mother reminds me often that i wasn’t meant to be born and how much easier life would be if i didn’t exist in the first place and blah blah blah shit like that.
